title: This NVIDIA Partner Is Already Up 123% in 2026, but Agentic AI Could Drive Its Next Growth Wave

content_html:
Quick Read

  • PENG surged 145% and MU jumped 188% year to date as AI factory demand fuels triple-digit revenue growth at both companies.

  • Shaikh argues that agentic AI's continuous 24/7 operation makes memory the primary performance and scalability bottleneck in AI factories, not GPU throughput.

  • With 89% of operating profit from memory and a beta of 2.83, PENG's upside and downside both hinge on the AI memory cycle.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Penguin Solutions CEO Kash Shaikh appeared on CNBC on July 29 with his thesis for the current AI cycle: "Memory is the new compute, especially with agentic AI." As autonomous AI agents evolve from short prompt-and-response interactions into workloads operating around the clock, he expects the primary bottleneck in an AI factory to increasingly shift toward memory bandwidth and capacity rather than GPU throughput alone.

Shaikh described his company plainly: "Penguin Solutions is an AI factory platform company. We sit at the intersection of two very high-demand markets, AI infrastructure and memory." He added that "enterprises, governments around the world and the new cloud providers are racing to build the AI factories" and that backlogs now extend multiple quarters.

Revenue Soared 48% as AI and Memory Demand Exploded

Penguin Solutions (NASDAQ:PENG) has become one of the most direct public-market vehicles for the memory-as-bottleneck thesis. Shares are up 123% since the start of 2026, with the company supporting a market cap of nearly $2.47 billion and analysts carrying a Buy consensus with a $74.29 price target, implying meaningful upside from the stock's current price of $43.70.

The fundamentals back the CEO's confidence. In fiscal Q3 2026, company-wide revenue grew 48% year over year, and the memory and AI infrastructure business grew over 104% year over year to represent over 75% of total net sales. Q3 saw revenue of $478.71 million, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.84, beating consensus by 13.61% and 49.33%, respectively.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Management responded by raising fiscal 2026 net sales growth guidance to 22% ±2% and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $2.60 ±$0.05. Penguin was also recently named an NVIDIA AI Factory Specialized Partner and Dell's Global Alliances Americas AI Partner of the Year.

Why Agentic AI Could Make Memory the Next Great Bottleneck

CEO Shaikh's argument turned to how agentic workloads behave. Where advisory AI answers a question and stops, agentic AI is "performing tasks, automating workflows, and it is working 24/7." Continuous context windows, persistent KV caches, and long-running tool use all pile pressure onto memory subsystems. Penguin's MemoryAI CXL-based KV cache server, already deployed at a Tier One financial institution, is designed for exactly that workload.

Penguin Solutions 首席执行官 Kash Shaikh 于 7 月 29 日出现在 CNBC 上，发表了他关于当前人工智能周期的论文：“内存是新的计算，尤其是代理人工智能。” 随着自主人工智能代理从短暂的提示和响应交互演变为全天候运行的工作负载，他预计人工智能工厂的主要瓶颈将越来越多地转向内存带宽和容量，而不仅仅是 GPU 吞吐量。

Shaikh 简单地描述了他的公司：“Penguin Solutions 是一家人工智能工厂平台公司。 我们位于人工智能基础设施和内存这两个需求非常高的市场的交汇处。” 他补充说，“世界各地的企业、政府和新的云提供商都在竞相建设人工智能工厂”，积压的订单现在已经延长了多个季度。

AI 和内存需求爆炸式增长，收入飙升 48%

Penguin Solutions（纳斯达克股票代码：PENG）已成为内存瓶颈论最直接的公开市场工具之一。 自 2026 年初以来，该公司股价已上涨 123%，其市值接近 24.7 亿美元，分析师一致给予买入评级，目标价为 74.29 美元，这意味着该股当前价格 43.70 美元有较大上涨空间。

基本面支撑了首席执行官的信心。 2026财年第三季度，全公司收入同比增长48%，内存和人工智能基础设施业务同比增长超过104%，占总净销售额的75%以上。 第三季度营收为 4.7871 亿美元，非 GAAP 摊薄后每股收益为 0.84 美元，分别超出市场预期 13.61% 和 49.33%。

管理层的回应是将 2026 财年净销售增长指导上调至 22% ±2%，将非 GAAP 每股收益指导提高至 2.60 ±0.05 美元。 Penguin 最近还被评为 NVIDIA AI Factory 专业合作伙伴和戴尔全球联盟年度美洲 AI 合作伙伴。

为什么代理人工智能会使内存成为下一个巨大瓶颈

首席执行官谢赫的论点转向代理工作负载的行为方式。 咨询式人工智能回答问题后就停止了，而代理式人工智能则“执行任务，自动化工作流程，并且 24/7 全天候工作”。 连续的上下文窗口、持久的 KV 缓存和长时间运行的工具都会给内存子系统带来压力。 Penguin 基于 MemoryAI CXL 的 KV 缓存服务器已部署在一级金融机构中，专为该工作负载而设计。
